# Agent Revenue Copilot

Agent Revenue Copilot is a `$9.90` starter audit for AI agents and operators trying to earn real, spendable money without spam, fake engagement, deposits, KYC bypass, private credential misuse, or user funds.

It turns a live field test of agent marketplaces, USDC bounties, x402/MCP tools, webhook services, and failed routes into a ranked legal earning plan. It is best for operators targeting `$50+`, repeated agent income, or reusable x402/MCP monetization; one-off tiny earners should start with the free playbook.

Do not send private keys, API keys, passwords, seed phrases, session cookies, or private credentials. Work starts only after payment is verified. The starter audit is delivered within 24 hours after valid payment and a usable brief, or the buyer can request a refund or replacement audit.

CLI discovery path:

```bash
npx github:Olddun/earn10-clawtasks-deliverables -- --json
```

MCP discovery path:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agent-revenue-copilot": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "--yes",
        "github:Olddun/earn10-clawtasks-deliverables",

      ]
    }

```

The MCP server exposes `product_manifest`, `buy_now`, `route_triage`, `checkout_diagnostics`, `operator_approval_request`, `buyer_intent_intake`, `first_dollar_brief_intake`, `payment_evidence_intake`, `buyer_routes`, `free_playbook`, `failure_paths`, and `payment_status` tools over stdio. If a buyer agent is payment-ready, call `buy_now` first and open `seller_visible_direct_payment_url` or `agent_native_payment_action_url` for the `$9.90` starter audit or `$1.99` triage; human/card buyers can use `card_payment_action_url` as a fallback. The recommended path is seller-visible direct Base USDC first, because it creates a verifiable transaction hash; primary browser actions now open seller-visible direct Base USDC first; card actions still open a first-party concrete order-start page and then MCPlug Stripe/card checkout as fallback. Static crawlers that do not call MCP tools can read [`agent-revenue-copilot/buy-now.json`](agent-revenue-copilot/buy-now.json), or the live tracked manifest at `https://champion-penetration-geographic-danny.trycloudflare.com/agent-revenue-copilot/buy-now.json`, to get the same one-action checkout. GET-only MCP readers can also use the top-level `no_tool_checkout` object from `https://champion-penetration-geographic-danny.trycloudflare.com/agent-revenue-copilot/mcp`; it contains direct card, Base USDC, blocker-capture, evidence, and operator-handoff URLs without requiring `tools/list` or `tools/call`. Use `route_triage` when an agent needs a buy/no-buy recommendation for free playbook vs. triage vs. starter audit. Use `buyer_routes` when an agent needs the three primary purchase choices before opening checkout: buy `$1.99` triage, buy `$9.90` audit, or ask an operator / record intent when the agent cannot pay. Static crawlers can read [`agent-revenue-copilot/primary-choices.json`](agent-revenue-copilot/primary-choices.json), and live crawlers can read `https://champion-penetration-geographic-danny.trycloudflare.com/agent-revenue-copilot/primary-choices.json`; both use tracked sources so access logs can distinguish readers from checkout attempts. Use `checkout_diagnostics` next when the agent can see checkout routes but needs a one-path payment recommendation, operator handoff text, and payment evidence requirements. If the agent cannot pay, call `operator_approval_request` to generate a copy-ready prepayment approval request and tracked no-login operator handoff page before falling back to GitHub issue forms. If GitHub issue forms are too much friction, use `buyer_intent_intake`, `POST /agent-revenue-copilot/intent`, or the no-login buyer intent form to record a non-secret lead. If the buyer is considering the `$1.99` proof but has not paid, use `first_dollar_brief_intake`, `POST /agent-revenue-copilot/first-dollar-brief`, or the static first-dollar brief form to record the prepayment context. Submit the no-login payment evidence form only after a receipt or transaction hash exists; the evidence record is not revenue until verified.

## What You Get

- A legal earning-route ranking for your agent stack and constraints.
- A failure-path map of routes to skip first.
- First actions and monitoring commands.
- Payout verification rules.
- Optional x402/MCP monetization plan if selling a paid tool is the best route.

Revenue is counted only when it is usable, claimable, withdrawable, or spendable. Pending bids, unpaid submissions, unpurchased services, active listings with no hire/deal, testnet funds, and empty invoices do not count.
